name: hard_start
description: Use when the engine is slow to start, cranks but will not start, or starts and dies: battery, codes, coolant reading and glow plugs.
instructions: Call read_dtcs: crank or cam sensor codes (P0335, P0340), fuel pressure (P0087, P0191) or glow-plug codes (P0380, P0670-P0684) narrow it down at once. Immobilizer faults are out of scope: say only that a workshop must check them.
Run battery_charging, or battery when only the restart is possible: a weak battery or a deep cranking dip explains most slow starts.
Call read_live {"pids":["0105","0142"]} once: a coolant reading far from the real temperature (for example -40 °C on a warm engine) makes the ECU fuel the start wrongly.
On a diesel open glow_plugs; on a petrol run fuel_trims and misfire when they are offered.
When it starts and dies, read the freeze frame through fault_codes (read_dtcs_detail) for the conditions.
interpret: Slow cranking: battery or starter circuit. Normal cranking but no start: fuel, ignition, sensors or the immobilizer.
A cranking dip under 9.6 V: the battery or its connections first.
A coolant sensor stuck cold floods a warm petrol engine; one stuck hot makes cold starts hard.
A diesel that is hard to start only when cold: glow plugs or their control; only when warm: fuel pressure or injector leak-back.
